summary: St. Francois County tower on a Missouri Conservation Commission towersite; quoted annual reports date a new tower to 1957-58 and a radio building to 1971-72. Marked removed, undated.

facts.status_note: The Central US Lookouts page marks the tower removed, with no date. A Wikipedia article on Jacobs Creek describes the lookout in the present tense; the two sources disagree. No source we found describes the site now.

events.note: New tower erected at French Village in fiscal 1957-58, per the Missouri Conservation Commission annual report quoted on the page; drive and parking built for the towersite
Concrete block building built at the tower to house a radio repeater, fiscal 1971-72 entry

evidence.supports: County, agency and PLSS location as printed on the page header

evidence.quote: A new tower was erected at French Village.

evidence.quote: Drive and parking facilities were constructed for the French Village towersite.

notes_for_editor: Every built and modified fact comes from annual-report entries that the Central US Lookouts page quotes; the report itself was not found and no other source confirmed the 1957-58 erection. Two web searches found nothing else on the tower's history. The Jacobs Creek article places a fire lookout on a mountain about 940 ft high beside the stream source; its source-area coordinates (37.9775, -90.42417) are a few hundred metres from our recorded coordinates (37.9814, -90.4247), so it is probably the same mountain. The article is undated and its present tense conflicts with the removed status. The page carries a photo credited to Bob Frakes dated May 2016 (already in the record); it is not clear whether it shows the tower standing, so the removal date is unknown. A towerdex listing for a 274.9 ft structure in French Village was blocked (403) and is not used; it appears to be a modern communications structure, not confirmed to be on this site.
